name: MOSS Turbo
summary: MOSS-Image with its 8-step turbo LoRA: a full 1 MP picture in 8 to 15 steps, with guidance between 1.0 and 1.8, for drafts and batches.

source.notes: The user's turbo graph, converted with tools/import_workflow.py: MOSS-Image int8, the 9B qwen text encoder, the small flux2 VAE, MOSS_8_STEPS_lora_latest on the model and er_sde / simple. The original TextGenerate branch (qwen rewriting the prompt) and the skip-layer guidance branch are both kept behind switches; rewrite is on by default like the original, cfg and steps are the two knobs this app adds.

inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.default: Cinematic night street photograph: a model in an exaggerated balloon-sleeve white wool coat walking toward camera under a huge illuminated theatre marquee, wet asphalt with long reflections, warm tungsten glow against cold blue night, anamorphic flare, 35mm film grain, low angle

inputs.label: Rewrite the prompt
inputs.help: The original workflow passes your text through the 9B qwen as a prompt engineer first. On: fuller prompts, one more model pass. Off: your words go straight to the image model.

inputs.label: Steps
inputs.help: The turbo LoRA is trained for 8 steps; 10 to 15 recover detail at a little cost.

inputs.label: Guidance
inputs.help: How hard the prompt is followed. 1.0 is loose and fast, 1.8 sticks to the words; the plain app runs 2.5 without the LoRA.

notes: The same weights as MOSS Image with MOSS_8_STEPS_lora_latest (strength 1.0) on the diffusion model and er_sde at 8 steps. Guidance is the one dial worth learning: 1.2 to 1.5 keeps a scene natural, 1.7 to 1.8 makes text and layout obey. The LoRA is a local file, not in the image-moss pack: keep it in ComfyUI/models/loras. Rewrite on sends your prompt through qwen first, as the original workflow did.

test.prompt: a red bicycle against a white wall, studio light
